messages:
mike: Quick flag: region compare in the latency dashboard shows eu-central p99 LOWER than us-east for the same endpoint. p50/p95 look fine. anyone else seeing weird regional flips?

jess: Which widget? rollup or raw per-host?

mike: rollup widget (latency -> region breakdown). I ran host-level queries and raw p99 aligns with expectation (eu higher).

rachel: sounds like a rollup artifact. we've seen t-digest compression do funky things on tails when samples are low. what's the rollup compression param?

own: good call. autoscale tweaked metrics defaults yesterday. infra-bot, did we change tdigest settings?

infra-bot: config change: metrics.tdigest.compression = 200 -> 80 at 7768998000 (triggered by autoscaler).

rachel: there it is. compression=80 can underrepresent extreme tail, especially with ~100-200 samples. does the widget show sample counts?

mike: no, the dashboard only shows p50/p95/p99. I ran `SELECT count(*) FROM rollup WHERE region='eu-central' AND window=5m` and saw ~140 samples. us-east had ~4200.

ux-lina: UX note: showing quantiles without sample_count + method is confusing. Can we surface sample_count and an estimation method badge (t-digest, compression)?

jess: also propose an "unreliable" marker when sample_count < 500 and compression < 150. Quick heuristic.

own: pragmatic fix: revert compression to 200 for rollup quantiles now, then follow up with smarter tiers. I can flip it.

infra-bot: deploy: metrics-config v3.5 apply queued by owen at 7769003000.

rachel: longer term: add exact-percentile fallback for small-sample rollups using raw histograms (we keep them for 24h). I'll draft a design.

mike: thanks. action items: owen revert compression for rollups, ux-lina add mock for sample_count/method badge, rachel draft fallback plan, jess add dashboard threshold rules.

own: reverted compression to 200 in prod at 7769003600. monitoring now.

mike: rechecked after the revert; rollup p99 now matches host queries.

jess: nice. let's also add the tooltip that shows: "method: t-digest (compression=200), samples=140" and an orange dot if unreliable.

ux-lina: will post 2 mock options in the channel.

rachel: starting postmortem note linking autoscale tweak -> compression change -> misleading p99. will include recommended dashboard UX changes.

mike: TL;DR: p99 inversion caused by low tdigest compression on sparse regional rollups + missing sample_count on widgets. Fix: revert compression + add provenance info to UI.

own: closing when postmortem + UX mocks land."
